title: Glowing skateboard
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffff88' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffff88' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='wheelGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffaa22' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffaa22' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='48' ry='22' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- deck -->
  <rect x='10' y='42' width='80' height='9' rx='4' fill='#44ddff'/>
  <rect x='10' y='44' width='80' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#88eeff'/>
  <!-- nose and tail curves -->
  <path d='M10 46 Q6 46 6 43 Q6 40 10 40' fill='#44ddff' stroke='#88eeff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M90 46 Q94 46 94 43 Q94 40 90 40' fill='#44ddff' stroke='#88eeff' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- deck top highlight -->
  <rect x='14' y='42' width='72' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#bbffff'/>

  <!-- trucks/axles -->
  <rect x='24' y='51' width='10' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#ffcc44'/>
  <rect x='66' y='51' width='10' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#ffcc44'/>

  <!-- wheel glows -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='60' r='9' fill='url(#wheelGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='60' r='9' fill='url(#wheelGlow)'/>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='59' r='5' fill='#ff7700'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='59' r='3' fill='#ffcc55'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='59' r='1.5' fill='#ffee99'/>

  <circle cx='71' cy='59' r='5' fill='#ff7700'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='59' r='3' fill='#ffcc55'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='59' r='1.5' fill='#ffee99'/>

  <!-- deck glowing stripes -->
  <rect x='20' y='43.5' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffff66'/>
  <rect x='36' y='43.5' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ff66cc'/>
  <rect x='52' y='43.5' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#66ff88'/>
  <rect x='68' y='43.5' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffff66'/>

  <!-- sparkle stars -->
  <g fill='#ffffaa'>
    <path d='M18 32 L19 35 L22 36 L19 37 L18 40 L17 37 L14 36 L17 35 Z'/>
    <path d='M82 28 L83 31 L86 32 L83 33 L82 36 L81 33 L78 32 L81 31 Z'/>
    <path d='M50 28 L51 30 L53 31 L51 32 L50 34 L49 32 L47 31 L49 30 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
